title: Data Systems Specialist (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS, DIR IC4
raw_text:
13.     MOS 8846, Data Systems Specialist (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS, DIR IC4

    a. Summary. Data Systems Specialists manage the operation of a data
systems activity that encompasses systems for recording, collecting,
controlling, verifying, interpreting, and presenting data used in planning
and directing automated Marine Corps data systems. Develop methodology and
concepts for optimum utilization of automatic data processing equipment
(ADPE). Develop ADPE requirements in coordination with users by assisting in
the preparation of formal data automation requirements. Monitor the design
and development of software/hardware (including modification to existing
programs and ADP systems) to ensure compatibility with operational
requirements. Monitor systems development programs to ensure that advances
in computer sciences technology and ADPE capabilities and limitations are
identified and employed.

       b.   Prerequisites.   Must be an unrestricted officer.

    c. Requirements. Complete the Computer Science Curriculum Number 368 at
the Naval Postgraduate School, Monterey, CA or equivalent postgraduate degree
from an accredited university.

       d.   Duties

        (1) Assists the commander in determining policy for installing and
operating ADP systems.

        (2) Formulates data processing policies and procedures to provide
systematic flow of automated data.

        (3) Determines and specifies requirements for transmission and
receipt of data via communication networks.

        (4) Provides technical knowledge and assistance for studies that
relate to ADPE configuration and employment.

        (5) Analyzes ADP requirements and recommends appropriate ADPE to
efficiently and effectively support approved systems.

        (6) Establishes organizational structure, operational procedures,
training, budget, and coordination for data processing activities.

        (7) Analyzes and reviews documentation required to support and
justify proposed or revised information or tactical data systems.

        (8) Coordinates the interface/compatibility of communications/
electronic equipment required to support remote or deployed commands.




                                           1-355                     Enclosure (1)
 1147                                                              NAVMC 1200.1L



        (9) Evaluates results of analysis data to provide a basis for
improving and/or revising programs or procedures to optimize ADPE
utilization.

        (10) Maintains direct and frequent contact with functional managers
concerning ADP systems development or maintenance problems that impact on
approved ADPE configuration.

        (11) Participates in information and tactical data systems studies to
determine the impact of employing alternative configurations of ADPE to
support present and future information and tactical data systems.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Computer and Information Systems Managers 11-3021.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

matches: Develop and maintain computerized record management systems to store and process data, such as personnel activities and information, and to produce reports.

Data Systems Specialists manage the operation of a data systems activity that encompasses systems for recording, collecting, controlling, verifying, interpreting, and presenting data used in planning and directing automated Marine Corps data systems.
Evaluate data processing applications for institutions under examination to develop recommendations for coordinating existing systems with examination procedures.
Develop methodology and concepts for optimum utilization of automatic data processing equipment (ADPE).
Discuss data needs with engineers, product managers, or data scientists to identify blockchain requirements.
Develop ADPE requirements in coordination with users by assisting in the preparation of formal data automation requirements.
Monitor functioning of equipment and make necessary modifications to ensure system operates in conformance with specifications.
Monitor the design and development of software/hardware (including modification to existing programs and ADP systems) to ensure compatibility with operational requirements.
Provide technical guidance or support for the development or troubleshooting of systems.
Monitor systems development programs to ensure that advances in computer sciences technology and ADPE capabilities and limitations are identified and employed.
Perform administrative duties, such as serving as department head.
d. Duties (1) Assists the commander in determining policy for installing and operating ADP systems.
Develop policies or requirements for data collection, processing, or reporting.
(2) Formulates data processing policies and procedures to provide systematic flow of automated data.
Receive, transmit, and control message traffic.
(3) Determines and specifies requirements for transmission and receipt of data via communication networks.
Provide technical or scientific guidance to technical staff in the conduct of biofuels research or development.
(4) Provides technical knowledge and assistance for studies that relate to ADPE configuration and employment.
Analyze system performance or operational requirements.
(5) Analyzes ADP requirements and recommends appropriate ADPE to efficiently and effectively support approved systems.
Analyze organizational, occupational, and industrial data to facilitate organizational functions and provide technical information to business, industry, and government.
(6) Establishes organizational structure, operational procedures, training, budget, and coordination for data processing activities.
Analyze information gathered by investigation and report findings and recommendations.
(7) Analyzes and reviews documentation required to support and justify proposed or revised information or tactical data systems.
Coordinate and link the computer systems within an organization to increase compatibility so that information can be shared.
(8) Coordinates the interface/compatibility of communications/ electronic equipment required to support remote or deployed commands.
Evaluate analytical methods and procedures to determine how they might be improved.
(9) Evaluates results of analysis data to provide a basis for improving and/or revising programs or procedures to optimize ADPE utilization.
Review and evaluate requests from engineers, managers, and technicians for system modifications.
(10) Maintains direct and frequent contact with functional managers concerning ADP systems development or maintenance problems that impact on approved ADPE configuration.
Store, retrieve, and manipulate data for analysis of system capabilities and requirements.

(11) Participates in information and tactical data systems studies to determine the impact of employing alternative configurations of ADPE to support present and future information and tactical data systems.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
